# Norris & Stevens, Inc.

> > Full-service commercial real estate and property management firm serving Portland, Oregon and the Willamette Valley with multifamily, industrial, office, and retail properties.

Norris & Stevens, Inc. specializes in commercial real estate brokerage, property management, and leasing throughout Oregon including Portland, Salem, Albany, Eugene, Beaverton, Tigard, and Corvallis. The firm manages multifamily apartment communities and commercial properties, with leadership from executives including Greg Nesting, David Keys, and Timothy Mitchell, and maintains affiliations with TCN Worldwide and SIOR.

## Key Topics

- Commercial Real Estate Brokerage
- Multifamily Property Management
- Portland Metro Area Properties
